reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Experimental Channel Resources (TLSRoute and TCPRoute): In v3, the Kubernetes Gateway API provider does not enable support for the experimental channel API…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Experimental channel API resources (TLSRoute and TCPRoute) are not supported by the Kubernetes Gateway API provider unless experimentalChannel is enabled.

proposed.statement: In v3 the Kubernetes Gateway API provider no longer enables experimental channel resources (TLSRoute, TCPRoute) by default; set providers.kubernetesGateway.experimentalChannel to true to enable them.
